zh.title: Frontier Airlines確認退出紐約JFK 轉向LGA與EWR
zh.summary: Frontier Airlines將退出JFK；營運重心轉至LGA與EWR
body: Frontier Airlines 已正式確認其在紐約約翰·甘迺迪國際機場（JFK）營運的最後一天服務日期。在該座紐約繁忙機場提供客運服務僅兩年時間後，該航空公司決定劃下句點並結束營運。
根據這項調整規劃，Frontier Airlines 將削減成本較高昂的航線營運，以提升整體營運資源的利用效率。
此外，Frontier Airlines 將營運資源進一步轉向紐約地區的其他機場，持續強化自紐約拉瓜地亞機場（LGA）與紐華克自由國際機場（EWR）起降的全年航班服務。

en.title: Frontier Airlines Confirms Departure From New York JFK Airport
en.summary: Frontier Airlines confirms exit from New York JFK; focuses flights on LGA and EWR airports.
body: Frontier Airlines has confirmed its final day of operations at New York John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK). The departure comes after the no-frills airline served the busiest New York City airport for only two years.
As part of its network adjustments, the carrier is trimming costly routes at JFK. Frontier Airlines is refocusing its resources on more effective airport operations.

Instead of maintaining services at JFK, Frontier Airlines will bolster its year-round flight schedule from two other major airports in the area. The airline will enhance its existing operations out of LaGuardia Airport (LGA) and Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR).

zh.title: 工研院推出首套非紅供應鏈檢測平台 逾20家無人機業者提出評測
zh.summary: 工研院開發非紅供應鏈檢測平台；已有逾20家無人機廠商提出評測需求
body: 工業技術研究院（工研院）宣佈與美方合作，開發出全台首套自製「非紅供應鏈檢測平台」。該平台將評測標準進行工具化與數位化轉換，旨在協助國內無人機及關鍵零組件業者進行產品健檢，確立供應鏈與資訊安全規範。工研院表示，目前已有超過20家國內無人機整機及關鍵零組件廠商提出評測需求，希望藉此進攻海外非紅供應鏈商機。
工研院指出，該院於今年6月正式與美國無人載具系統國際協會（AUVSI）簽署Green UAS授權評鑑及服務協議，成為AUVSI在台灣的第三方認可評鑑機構，同時也是美國境外首家取得該項認證資格的機構。透過此一資格，工研院得以協助台灣無人機廠商執行資安與供應鏈安全評測，為拓展國際市場建立可信度。
工研院機械與機電系統研究所智慧機械產業推動組長錢睿宏說明，目前工研院執行的Green UAS評測架構，直接對準美國國防合約管理局（DCMA）所建立的Blue UAS評測標準。Green UAS與Blue UAS在產品資安與供應鏈安全的評測要求上高度一致，兩者主要差異在於發證機關與目標市場，前者鎖定商業及非美國國防市場，後者則主要對準美國國防體系。
針對業者面臨範本不一與資料收集困難等挑戰，工研院開發的「非紅供應鏈檢測平台」可協助廠商從整架無人機一路盤點至關鍵零組件，確認製造商、供應商來源及潛在風險。業者可在正式申請Green UAS評測前進行預先分析與資料補強，避免送件後重複退件。此外，在台灣完成Green UAS評測後建立的測試數據與證據，未來亦可作為銜接Blue UAS審查的重要基礎，大幅降低營運與測試成本。

en.title: ITRI Unveils Non-Red Supply Chain Testing Platform for Drone Sector
en.summary: ITRI launched a non-red drone testing platform, with over 20 manufacturers seeking supply chain evaluations.
body: Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) has collaborated with US partners to develop the nation's first self-built non-red supply chain testing platform. The platform digitizes and toolifies evaluation standards to assist domestic drone and critical component manufacturers with cybersecurity and supply chain safety checks. ITRI announced that more than 20 domestic manufacturers have already requested evaluations to capture opportunities in global non-red supply chains.

The initiative follows ITRI's agreement signed in June with the Association for Uncrewed Vehicle Systems International (AUVSI). Under the agreement, ITRI became AUVSI's third-party evaluation institution in Taiwan and the first entity outside the United States authorized to conduct Green UAS assessments. This certification allows ITRI to provide domestic drone and component manufacturers with recognized security evaluations required for overseas market entry.

According to ITRI, the Green UAS evaluation framework executed by the institute aligns directly with the Blue UAS evaluation standard established by the US Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA). While Blue UAS targets the US defense market and Green UAS focuses on commercial and non-US defense sectors, both frameworks maintain highly consistent standards regarding product cybersecurity and supply chain risk verification.

The newly developed testing platform enables manufacturers to conduct pre-assessments and inventory tracking from complete drone units down to key components before formal Green UAS application. By auditing manufacturers, component suppliers, and potential cybersecurity vulnerabilities in advance, firms can avoid formal application rejections. Furthermore, product security data and supply chain evidence established through Green UAS testing in Taiwan can serve as a vital foundation for future Blue UAS reviews, saving testing time and reducing costs for local companies.

zh.title: 空中巴士A330neo尾翼檢查影響夏季交付；已找出原因並恢復交付
zh.summary: 空中巴士因尾翼檢查致A330neo夏季交付延誤；根源已確定並已恢復交付
body: 空中巴士（Airbus）旗下的 A330neo 客機交付作業在2026年夏季遭受嚴重延誤。根據相關消息指出，此波延誤主要是因為該型客機的水平尾翼（水平安定面）結構出現品質疑慮，導致空中巴士必須執行額外檢查並放緩整體生產系統運作。
據路透社引述知情人士消息透露，這項檢查程序的誘因，是在一次交付前的例行檢查過程中，工作人員在一架 A330neo 的機身結構內部發現了一件留置工具。為了維持航空安全標準，空中巴士管理層隨後要求工作人員對每一架 A330neo 客機進行全面檢驗，因而減緩了組裝線的產出速度。
空中巴士公布的數據反映出夏季檢驗對營運的影響。其官方交付紀錄顯示，該公司在2026年6月與7月的兩個月期間，完全未向客戶交付任何 A330neo 客機。而在2026年8月，空中巴士僅完成交付一架 A330neo 客機予星宇航空。在此之前的2026年前幾個月，空中巴士累計交付了九架 A330neo，分別為3月交付三架、4月交付兩架以及5月交付四架，而1月與2月則無交付紀錄。
對於交付受阻情事，空中巴士在發給彭博的聲明中證實，問題的根本原因已經被成功識別，並將該狀況描述為單一孤立事件。空中巴士明確指出，A330 系列客機的交付作業現已正式恢復。依據此前的營運預測，空中巴士原定目標為每月交付約四架 A330neo 客機，並規劃於2029年將該型號的月產量進一步提升至五架。
雖然 A330neo 機型的交付在夏季陷入短暫停頓，空中巴士的整體商用客機交付表現仍維持穩定增長。空中巴士於2026年8月7日確認，其於7月份單月向39家客戶共交付了67架客機。截至當時，該公司在2026年的年度累計交付量已達418架，優於2025年同期的373架。空中巴士在先前發布上半年與第二季財務業績時，亦重新確認其2026年全年交付約870架商用飛機的營運目標。

en.title: Airbus Resumes A330neo Deliveries Following Tail Inspection Delays
en.summary: Airbus resumes A330neo deliveries after horizontal tail inspections delayed summer aircraft handovers to customers.
body: Deliveries of Airbus A330neo aircraft experienced significant delays over the summer of 2026 following concerns related to the aircraft's horizontal tail plane. The extra inspection steps required on the horizontal stabilizer slowed down the production system across the manufacturing line.

According to reports from Reuters citing a person familiar with the matter, the inspections were triggered after a tool was discovered inside the structure of an A330neo during a pre-delivery inspection. Following the discovery, Airbus staff were directed to check every A330neo aircraft, creating a temporary disruption in output.

Delivery data published by Airbus underscores the impact of the inspection process on commercial operations. Airbus delivered no A330neo aircraft during June and July 2026. In August 2026, Airbus delivered only a single A330neo aircraft, which was transferred to STARLUX Airlines. Prior to August, Airbus had delivered nine A330neos in 2026, including three in March, two in April, and four in May, following zero deliveries in January and February.

In a statement provided to Bloomberg, Airbus confirmed that the root cause of the issue has been identified and described the situation as an isolated occurrence. Airbus emphasized that A330 deliveries have officially resumed. Based on earlier operational targets, Airbus aims to deliver around four A330neos per month, with plans to increase output to five per month in 2029.

Despite the summer bottleneck affecting the A330neo line, Airbus's overall commercial aircraft deliveries remained on an upward track. On August 7, 2026, Airbus confirmed that it delivered 67 aircraft to 39 customers during July 2026. Total year-to-date deliveries reached 418 aircraft compared to 373 at the same point in 2025, with Airbus reaffirming its annual goal of delivering around 870 commercial aircraft in 2026.

zh.title: 波音預測非洲民航機隊2045年前增逾一倍至1625架
zh.summary: 波音預測非洲航空客運量年增近6%；機隊2045年前將倍增至1625架
body: 波音（Boeing）於肯亞奈洛比發布2026年《商業市場展望》（Commercial Market Outlook）報告指出，受惠於年輕且日益城鎮化的人口、不斷增長的平民階級以及基礎設施改善，非洲地區的商業航空客運量預計在2045年前將以每年近6%的速度增長，成為全球增長最快的區域之一。
根據波音預測，為滿足日益成長的空中交通需求，非洲地區的商業飛機機隊規模將在未來20年內翻倍以上，從目前的755架大幅增加至2045年的1,625架。在預計交付的近1,200架新飛機中，約有870架將是單通道客機，主要用於支援不斷擴張的區域與國內航線網絡。
在遠程與貨運需求方面，波音預估非洲雙通道廣體客機的需求將成長一倍以上，以推動機隊現代化並支援長途國際航線發展。此外，隨著電商物流與高價值出口市場擴增，非洲的貨機機隊規模也預計將從現有的60架增加至150架。
針對航空服務與專業人才需求，波音《商業服務市場展望》指出，到2045年非洲的維修、修理、大修與改裝（MRO）及數位解決方案市場規模將達到1,400億美元。同時，波音《飛行員與技術人員展望》預估，隨著航空公司擴展機隊與航線網絡，該地區將需要75,000名新進航空專業人員，包含22,000名飛行員、25,000名技術人員與28,000名客艙組員。
波音商業行銷總經理沙哈布·馬丁（Shahab Matin）表示，非洲航空市場正進入由連通性改善與區域內旅遊擴展所推動的持續成長期。要滿足此項需求，需要致力於機隊現代化、擴充運能、數位解決方案以及人才培訓等全面投入。

en.title: Boeing Forecasts Africa Commercial Airplane Fleet to Double to 1,625 by 2045
en.summary: Boeing projects African airline fleets to double by 2045 driven by six percent annual passenger growth.
body: Boeing released its 2026 Commercial Market Outlook for Africa in Nairobi, Kenya, forecasting that the continent's commercial air passenger traffic will grow by nearly 6 percent annually through 2045. Driven by a young and increasingly urban population, an expanding middle class, and ongoing infrastructure improvements, Africa's air travel expansion is projected to rank among the fastest global growth rates over the next two decades.

To meet this expanding travel demand, Boeing projects that Africa's commercial airplane fleet will more than double over the next 20 years, expanding from 755 aircraft to 1,625 by 2045. The continent will require nearly 1,200 new airplane deliveries to support this expansion, with single-aisle aircraft accounting for 870 units to serve growing domestic and regional flight networks across the region.

Demand for widebody airplanes is also expected to more than double over the forecast period to support long-haul network growth and ongoing fleet modernization. In addition, Boeing forecasts that Africa's dedicated freighter fleet will expand from 60 to 150 aircraft as logistics operations, e-commerce adoption, and high-value export markets continue to develop across the continent.

The expansion of the regional aviation sector is anticipated to drive substantial demand for commercial aviation services and skilled workforce. Boeing's Commercial Services Market Outlook projects a $140 billion market for maintenance, repair, overhaul, modifications, and digital solutions in Africa through 2045. Furthermore, the manufacturer estimates that regional airlines will need 75,000 new aviation professionals, including 22,000 pilots, 25,000 technicians, and 28,000 cabin crew members.

Shahab Matin, Boeing managing director of Commercial Marketing, noted that Africa's aviation market is entering a sustained growth phase supported by improving connectivity and expanding intraregional travel. Meeting this growing demand will require sustained commitments to fleet modernization, capacity expansion, digital infrastructure, and workforce development across the continent.

zh.title: 聯合航空發表Mountain Ascent彩繪機身 擬2027年初投入營運
zh.summary: 聯合航空發表Mountain Ascent塗裝；預計2027年初投入營運
body: 聯合航空發表名為「Mountain Ascent」的全新山脈主題飛機塗裝，旨在宣傳其橫跨美國的冬季及滑雪航線。該特殊塗裝將塗刷於一架巴西航空工業E175客機上，預計於2027年初正式投入營運，服務包括阿斯彭、太陽谷及韋爾等滑雪勝地。
此設計機身後半部包裹著涵蓋雪山與綠坡的山脈圖案，並逐漸過渡至聯合航空標誌性的藍色尾翼。此外，聯合航空今年冬季新增的波士頓至傑克遜霍爾航線，將由126座波音737-700執飛，而非塗有新塗裝的E175客機。聯合航空同時也是美國滑雪與單板滑雪協會至2027年的官方夥伴。

en.title: United Airlines Unveils 'Mountain Ascent' Livery for Winter Ski Routes
en.summary: United Airlines unveiled its 'Mountain Ascent' livery, entering service on an Embraer E175 in early 2027.
body: United Airlines has unveiled a new mountain-themed aircraft livery named 'Mountain Ascent' to promote its winter and ski routes across the United States. The special design will be applied to an Embraer E175 aircraft serving mountain destinations, including Aspen, Sun Valley, and Vail, with entry into service planned for early 2027.

The aircraft design wraps the rear half of the fuselage in a snow-capped mountain motif before transitioning into the carrier's traditional blue tail. Separately, United's new winter route between Boston and Jackson Hole will be operated using a 126-seat Boeing 737-700 rather than the E175. The airline remains an official partner of US Ski and Snowboard through 2027.

zh.title: 阿聯酋航空發表A350新豪華經濟艙座椅 配備可調式隔板
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空發表A350電動豪華經濟艙座椅；配置28席與全高隔板
body: 阿聯酋航空（Emirates）發表全新電動豪華經濟艙座椅，該產品將於新接收的空中巴士（Airbus）A350客機上首次亮相。新座椅配置可調整高度的全高隱私隔板，並配備賽峰座椅（Safran Seats）的U-Dream頭靠，提供頭頸部支撐。
在艙內佈局方面，空中巴士A350客機將規劃28席豪華經濟艙座椅，採用2-3-2配置。座椅寬度為20吋，椅距達39吋，座椅可透過整合控制單元進行電動調整，並配備無線裝置充電、USB-C電源與13.3吋4K HDR觸控螢幕。此外，新A350客機亦新增左側與右側外部攝影機畫面。

en.title: Emirates Unveils New Electric Premium Economy Seat for Airbus A350 Fleet
en.summary: Emirates unveils a new electric premium economy seat for Airbus A350 aircraft with full-height privacy dividers.
body: Emirates has unveiled a new electrically powered premium economy seat featuring a full-height adjustable privacy screen, which will debut on its newly delivered Airbus A350 aircraft. The upgraded cabin section is fitted with 28 seats arranged in a 2-3-2 seating configuration.

Manufactured with Safran Seats' U-Dream headrest, each seat measures 20 inches in width and provides up to 39 inches of pitch. Passengers can electrically adjust the seat positions using an integrated control unit. Additional onboard amenities include wireless device charging, USB-C power ports, and a 13.3-inch 4K HDR touchscreen display. The new A350 aircraft also feature additional left and right-side external cameras.

facts.claim: Emirates unveiled an electrically powered premium economy seat with a full-height privacy screen for its Airbus A350 aircraft.
facts.sourceQuote: Emirates has unveiled the world’s first electrically powered premium economy seat with an enhanced U-Dream headrest that offers neck support and a full-height adjustable privacy screen between every seat.

facts.claim: The premium economy cabin on newly delivered Airbus A350 aircraft will feature 28 seats fitted in a 2-3-2 layout.
facts.sourceQuote: The upgraded product will debut on newly delivered Airbus A350 aircraft, where the Emirates premium economy will be fitted with 28 seats in a 2-3-2 configuration.

facts.claim: The seat measures 20 inches wide with up to 39 inches of pitch and features electric adjustment controls.
facts.sourceQuote: According to Emirates’ announcement, the new seat is 20 inches wide with up to 39 inches of pitch.

facts.claim: Amenities include wireless device charging, USB-C power, a 13.3-inch 4K HDR touchscreen, and new side external camera views.
facts.sourceQuote: Other additions include wireless device charging, USB-C power and a tray table incorporating a phone holder. Entertainment is provided through a 13.3” 4K HDR touchscreen.
